metadata.oracle_evidence: solution/trajectory.npz replays a Sharpa Wave authoring trajectory (3,006 controls; success after 2,806) in both modes: two fresh-process replays with identical state hashes, float32 rows succeed, Harbor oracle 1 in privileged and standard mode (standard: rows submitted through the public client, live hash = replay hash).

notes.layout: Both hands hang from the same six-axis wrist stage, with the same wrist joints, ranges, gains and start targets; the wrist x/y/z targets are offsets from the stage origin (stage origin (0.55, -0.1, 1.15) m) along the world axes, and at zero wrist angles the palm faces down with the fingers along +x.
